notes.subject: Kristy call notes — final handwritten batch
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten sheet lists Snake River Stampede, 208-466-8497, sstampede@earthlink.net, with left message. Adventure Zone also has prior email outreach. Current official information already lists the 2027 rodeo for June 15-19 and current office contact 208-466-8497.
